entries:
I come shop at the Shopping Mall a lot
because I want all the TMs!

There are even some people in the mall
who will challenge you to battles.

The thing I buy most often is the item
that raises a Pokémon's HP, called HP Up.{VAR BE01}
There are also a lot of other items that
catch my eye.

Welcome to Shopping Mall Nine!
It's called Nine because it's on Route 9.{VAR BE01}
You can remember it by thinking of this:
“Done shopping? Nein!"

Have you heard? There's a cave
along Route 9.{VAR BE01}
I don't know exactly where it is or
what's in it, though.

So you know Thunderstones make certain
Pokémon evolve, then? Niiice!{VAR BE01}

Meeting here must be fate!
This is for you!{VAR BE01}

I've heard a Pokémon called Eelektrik
evolves with the Thunderstone.

Shopping Mall Nine
Colorful and wonderful!
